method: Independent documentation review of the exact git-tracked 15 Markdown files. Every current file was read for raw SHA-256, size, heading inventory and Markdown-link extraction; local targets and Markdown fragments were checked. Manual review covers current user-facing contracts, commands, new feature statements and historical evidence boundaries, with retained substantive deployment/runtime analysis explicitly distinguished from fresh focused reading. Large append-only historical logs were reviewed through current sections, complete section/link inventory and relevant dated evidence; this is not a claim of fresh line-by-line rereading or reexecution of every archived test. Local current implementation and selected evidence JSON were cross-checked. Only the two explicitly authorized Markdown files were edited; no production-code edits, test execution or online operations.

Read provenance/version/licensing attribution; matched CLI 0.164.0 to local provenance and package pins. This is attribution consistency review, not a legal opinion.

Read fixed-version generation and authoritative protocol boundary, no latest-version assertion and no claimed paid inference; matched local generated protocol/provenance and actual current history/resume separation.

Read coverage mapping, resource policies, declared integration limits and real local chain descriptions, with historical snapshot boundaries retained. Corrected current native sudo modes and protected legacy recovery distinction; no reinterpretation of loopback/native fixtures as commercial acceptance.

Reviewed current pending-followup notice, historical CI9/CI8 and older source-specific status, exact evidence links and orchestration declarations. Independently confirmed root corrected historical pending-deployment wording against hosted-ci9/deployment-ci9 JSON. Historical sections remain historical, not a fresh rerun of their tests.

Reviewed current followup and CI9 checkpoint sections, all section headings/link targets and chronological/source boundaries throughout the retained log. Read entire capability classification and common-workflow limits, 178 request count partition, external account/network caveats and per-platform historical checks; no completion-percentage or universal optional-field claim.

Read entire user-workflow repair summary, explicit local substitute/isolated-host evidence and history race limitations; historical Linux CI failure is not claimed reproduced or explained by a single proven cause.

Read browser implementation/bounds and historical phase/round evidence; checked local draft/history/operation/owner semantics and explicit exclusions for real IME, commercial models and native PTY. Earlier counts/screenshots remain scoped to their recorded implementations.
